game_title: Off By One Fixer – Woodcutter Clearing Race
game_concept: A racing platformer set in Mystic Forest – Woodcutter Clearing, a woodcutter's clearing: the forest ranger must handle cursed treants while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Off By One Fixer: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one.
theme: Mystic Forest – Woodcutter Clearing: a woodcutter's clearing
core_gameplay_loop: In Woodcutter Clearing, repeat each round: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the forest ranger ahead. Then check the fixes value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the fairy lantern by solving code steps involving fixes that move the forest ranger forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the fairy lantern first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Off By One Fixer
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
